title: Yellow Silky Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A winey and festive Syrian dish featuring matcha and halal-friendly ingredients, perfect for special occasions. The namul-blanch-season method ensures tender and flavorful lamb.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine, matcha powder, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it on the grill for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the kebabs in the pita bread with your choice of toppings.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
